text:
The summary is accurate throughout. The starting rent, 1 March review date, CPI floor and cap of 3–5% for years 2–4, and the year 5 market review by the landlord's valuer all match the source. So do the no-fall-below-year-4 rule, the 30-day independent valuer option with equal cost split, the separate outgoings, the 14 days' notice and the late-notice rule. It also keeps the points a manager needs.

However, it breaks the explicit limit of under 120 words. I count about 131 words including the title and closing line, and about 115 without the title and closing line. The overrun is modest, but it is a clear failure of a stated constraint. The "Other points" bullet and the closing line could easily have been trimmed.

Score: 6
